paperTitle: GuidedVLA: Specifying Task-Relevant Factors via Plug-and-Play Action Attention Specialization
organization: Fudan University / Shanghai Jiao Tong University / OpenDriveLab, The University of Hong Kong

benchmarks.label: LIBERO-Plus
benchmarks.detail: Suites: spatial 84.0 · object 80.9 · goal 70.8 · long 66.2 | Tasks: camera 73.7 · robot 51.4 · language 62.6 · light 94.6 · background 89.0 · noise 85.2 · layout 79.9 | Table I and Appendix Table IV | Notes: GuidedVLA with all guided heads; trained on official LIBERO and evaluated zero-shot on LIBERO-Plus.

benchmarks.label: RoboTwin 2.0
benchmarks.detail: Tasks: Adjust Bottle 99 · Beat Hammer Block 95 · Click Bell 65 · Dump Bin BigBin 93 · Moving PlayingCard away 98 · Lift Pot 99 · Place Burger Fries 98 · Place Can Basket 78 | Figure 5 and Appendix Table V | Notes: GuidedVLA with all heads on 8 representative RoboTwin 2.0 tasks; table reports a 90.63% average.
